name: AI Dispatcher by FieldCamp
description:
FieldCamp AI Dispatcher brings your field-service operations into Claude. Connect your FieldCamp workspace and Claude can see your live jobs, technicians, daily schedule, and dispatch performance, then act on them: create jobs, run AI dispatch optimization across your team, and accept or reject the AI's suggested assignments — all from chat.
It is built for dispatchers and operations teams who want to plan and adjust their day conversationally: "What's on the board today?", "Create a job for 12 Main St tomorrow morning", "Run dispatch and show me the plan", "Accept the suggestion for the Smith job". The connector also surfaces technician and job details, the skills catalogue, EV charging stations and a route map, and multi-stage project schedules.
Read tools only retrieve data and never modify it; write tools (create job, run dispatch, accept/reject) make explicit, reviewable changes. Every tool is annotated with read-only or write/destructive hints.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AI Dispatcher by FieldCamp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AI Dispatcher by FieldCamp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://dispatcher.fieldcamp.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AI Dispatcher by FieldCamp MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI Dispatcher by FieldCamp lists 14 MCP tools, including accept_suggestion, call_api, create_job, discover_charging_stations, get_credit_balance, get_performance, get_schedule, list_capabilities, list_charging_stations, list_jobs, list_projects, and list_technicians.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AI Dispatcher by FieldCamp?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AI Dispatcher by FieldCamp in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does AI Dispatcher by FieldCamp MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI Dispatcher by FieldCamp requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops AI Dispatcher by FieldCamp?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI Dispatcher by FieldCamp is developed by FieldCamp. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
